text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
label: Matthew 2:1

text: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
label: Matthew 2:2

text: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
label: Matthew 2:3

text: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
label: Matthew 2:4

text: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
label: Matthew 2:5

text: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
label: Matthew 2:6

text: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
label: Matthew 2:7

text: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
label: Matthew 2:8

text: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.
label: Matthew 2:9

text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
label: Matthew 2:10

text: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
label: Matthew 2:11

text: Being warned in a dream that they shouldn’t return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
label: Matthew 2:12

text: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
label: Matthew 2:13

text: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt,
label: Matthew 2:14

text: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
label: Matthew 2:15

text: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
label: Matthew 2:16

text: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
label: Matthew 2:17

text: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
label: Matthew 2:18

text: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
label: Matthew 2:19

text: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
label: Matthew 2:20

text: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
label: Matthew 2:21

text: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,
label: Matthew 2:22

text: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
label: Matthew 2:23

statement: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king.
label: Jesus born in Bethlehem of Judea

statement: Herod the Great was king over Judea at the time of Jesus' birth.
label: Herod the Great was king over Judea

statement: Magi (wise men) from the east came to Jerusalem seeking the newborn king of the Jews.
label: Magi came from the east to Jerusalem

statement: The Magi said they saw his star in the east and came to worship the one born king of the Jews.
label: The Magi saw his star in the east

statement: Herod gathered the chief priests and scribes of the people to ask where the Christ was to be born.
label: Herod consulted the chief priests and scribes

statement: The chief priests cited the prophet Micah, who located the coming ruler in Bethlehem of Judea.
label: Micah located the ruler in Bethlehem

statement: The Magi offered the child gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.
label: Gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh

statement: Joseph fled by night with the child and his mother into Egypt and stayed there until Herod's death.
label: Flight of the family into Egypt

statement: Matthew applied Hosea 11:1, 'Out of Egypt I called my son,' to Jesus' return from Egypt.
label: Hosea 11:1 applied to the return from Egypt

statement: Herod ordered the killing of all the male children in Bethlehem and its surrounding region aged two years and under.
label: Herod killed the boys of Bethlehem aged two and under

statement: Herod died after the Magi's visit and before Joseph's return from Egypt.
label: Herod the Great died

statement: Archelaus son of Herod was ruling over Judea when Joseph returned from Egypt.
label: Archelaus ruled Judea after Herod

statement: Fearing Archelaus in Judea, Joseph settled the family in a city called Nazareth in Galilee.
label: Joseph settled the family in Nazareth

label: Wikipedia: Herodian coinage (Archelaus)
title: Herodian coinage
excerpt: The most common coins of Herod Archelaus are small prutot depicting a bunch of grapes, also one of the seven species, and a crested helmet with his name (Herod) and title (Ethnarch) in Greek (ΗΡΩΔ ΕΘΝ), and a ship's prow and wreath with his name and title abbreviated.

label: Wikipedia: Bethlehem
title: Bethlehem
excerpt: Archaeological confirmation of Bethlehem as a city in the Kingdom of Judah was uncovered in 2012 at the archaeological dig at the City of David in the form of a bulla (seal impression in dried clay) in ancient Hebrew script that reads "From the town of Bethlehem to the King".

label: Wikipedia: Church of the Nativity
title: Church of the Nativity
excerpt: In Bethlehem the cave is pointed out where He was born, and the manger in the cave where He was wrapped in swaddling clothes. And the rumor is in those places, and among foreigners of the Faith, that indeed Jesus was born in this cave who is worshiped and reverenced by the Christians.

label: Wikipedia: Nazareth (2009 house)
title: Nazareth
excerpt: In 2009, Israeli archaeologist Yardenna Alexandre excavated archaeological remains in Nazareth that date to the time of Jesus in the early Roman period.

label: Wikipedia: Nazareth (Caesarea inscription)
title: Nazareth
excerpt: A Hebrew inscription found in Caesarea dating to the late 3rd or early 4th century mentions Nazareth as the home of the priestly Hapizzez/Hafizaz family after the Bar Kokhba revolt (AD 132-135).
